artwork_guidelines_page.title: Artwork Guidelines
quick_checklist: All linked files, images, and fonts are placed in separate folders
artwork_guidelines_page.bleed: A 1/8" border must be added to pictures and designs bleeding to the edge, so that there is no white space or border showing around the artwork.
artwork_guidelines_page.safe_zone: Keep text at least 1/4" away from the paper edge or the trim line to prevent accidental cropping.
artwork_guidelines_page.colour_mode: All colours in CMYK mode. For 1-3 colour Pantone jobs, specify colours as spot colours and ensure they separate correctly. Many Pantone colours shift when converted to 4-colour process.
resolution: All images and pictures should be 300 dpi
Rasterized text or logos should be 1200 dpi
Screen values between 133 lpi and 150 lpi
photoshop: Save as PDF, embed all fonts, screen value 133 lpi
artwork_guidelines_page.proofs: PDF soft proofs are provided for layout only, not colour accuracy; hard-copy proof available on request.
artwork_guidelines_page.scanning: Scan transparencies and line art at 100% of final size (or 1/4 or 1/2 if data size is prohibitive).

faq_page.colour: Online system supports RGB and maps RGB to CMYK for 4-colour printing (note: contradicts design guide asking for CMYK).
faq_page.turnaround_general: In-store orders usually ready same day, or next day if placed before 12 noon. Online orders usually take 5 business days if placed before 2pm, excluding shipping.

artwork_and_file_setup.product_templates: Most product pages have a Templates tab offering downloadable PDF/JPG templates per size; the template files load via JavaScript and were not downloaded.

notes: Looking for high-impact custom vinyl stickers that stand out? Our die-cut stickers are the ultimate solution for artists, small businesses, and brands. This "custom shape" finish eliminates unnecessary white space, ensuring your personalized stickers look professional and sleek on any surface.

custom_order_text_on_pages.name: Kiss-Cut Sticker Singles
notes: Looking for a premium sticker that's as easy to use as it is beautiful? Our custom single-kiss-cut stickers are exactly what you need.

What is a Kiss Cut? "Kiss cuts stickers" only slice through the top vinyl layer. The paper backing stays whole, creating a protective frame around your sticker. This means your intricate designs are protected during shipping and handling, and your customers will have zero trouble peeling the sticker off the backing.
Infinite Customization: Whether it’s your brand logo, custom artwork, or a fun phrase, we precision-cut the vinyl to follow the exact contours of your design.
